g.text: The only durable state this design needs -- the generation hot path touches no database at all.
0-1023, the natural key -- the slot being allocated
process / instance identifier holding this slot
self-healing TTL -- indexed for the reclaim sweep
only populated in a multi-region deployment
Indexes: unique index on machine_id (already the PK) enforces "no two active leases share a slot" at
the DB level. Index on lease_expires_at supports the reclaim sweep for crashed holders.
Consistency: strong. Two processes must never both believe they hold the same machine_id --
the one place in this entire design where a real consistency guarantee is required.
